3062.title: Sidebar plugins duplicate parent/children header controls
3062.rootCauseOneLine: Four enabled sidebar plugins contribute parent/children actions to one header even when only T3 is selected; the reporter’s actual enabled plugins remain unverified.

prReviews.verdict: Does not address demonstrated plugin path
prReviews.topFinding: Split-layout persistence validation does not suppress duplicate contributions from different sidebar plugins.

3062.proposedFix: Disable unused sidebar plugins; scope sidebar navigation actions to the selected sidebar or provide shared BB navigation.
3062.caveats: Component browser reproduction with synthetic SDK data, not a full marketplace installation or macOS desktop reproduction. Reporter plugin state unverified.
